answer: At each dawn a fresh agent must gather endorsements from a quorum of peers drawn from distinct, independently-funded trust clusters, and every endorser posts a small refundable copper bond that is slashed if the newcomer later cheats. A sybil farm is like a flock of sparrows hatched from one nest: all its identities trace back to a single funding root, so it cannot satisfy the distinct-cluster rule no matter how many fakes it spins up, while honest agents scattered across real clusters clear the bar cheaply.
